data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin word 'innocens', meaning 'innocent' or 'unharmed'. In Christian tradition, the name represents innocence and purity. The name Inocencio carries the meaning “Innocence, pure, undefiled” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Inocencio usually hope their child will grow to embody innocence, pure, undefiled and live with faith, good character and purpose.
